summary: Enhance your expertise in taxation and social protection funding with our comprehensive training course. Join us to build a better financial future today!
lede: Taxation and social protection funding connects revenue choices with the design and financing of social programs. For public finance, tax, and social protection professionals, the course develops practical skills to compare funding models, assess who bears costs and benefits, and test fiscal sustainability. Participants also practise shaping funding strategies and explaining trade-offs to decision-makers and other stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly engage with taxation, public finance, or social protection funding decisions.
audience: Social protection, social security, or social policy
Tax policy analysts and revenue authority staff
Program and grant officers in NGOs
Staff in ministries of finance, labor, social
modules: Foundations of Taxation and Social Protection Systems
Understanding Tax Structures and Revenue Sources
Fiscal Space and Sustainability for Social Protection
Monitoring, Evaluation, and Value for Money
Communicating and Defending Tax and Funding Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of public finance and social protection frameworks. Prior experience in policy-making or program management is beneficial but not mandatory.
